title: Methotrexate in the Treatment of Distal Interphalangeal Joint Extensor Tendon Enthesopathy in Nail Psoriasis
brief_summary: The primary aim of the study is to assess the effect of methotrexate on the development of distal interphalangeal joint extensor tendon enthesopathy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with psoriatic changes in nails treated at the Rheumatological Clinic in Olsztyn and the Clinic of Dermatology, Sexually Transmitted Diseases and Clinical Immunology of the University of Warmia and Mazury in Olsztyn, in whom a US examination revealed DIP joint extensor tendon enthesopathy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients diagnosed with osteoarthritis of hands, those who work hard physically and those with changes in nails other than caused by psoriasis
study_population: Patients with psoriatic changes in nails with distal interphalangeal extensor tendon enthesopathy in ultrasound examination
